description: Send a reply now to the sender of an email (or the Reply-To address, if the email has one), or with replyAll also to the original To and Cc recipients; a copy is saved to Sent Items. This tool cannot recall it after sending. To save a reply without sending it, use create_reply_draft.

replyAll.description: Also send the reply to the original To and Cc recipients (default: false: only the sender, or the Reply-To address if the email has one)

name: reply_to_email
